description:
Create a new bulk-call campaign. Only name, phone_number_id and a
contact_list are needed to dial a list now; every other field adds
one behaviour on top (drafts, rotation, filtering, scheduling,
retries, dynamic feeding).

The guide below the field reference walks the whole journey: the
first campaign and its response, each behaviour with a working
request, every refusal message with its fix, and the endpoints that
operate a campaign once it runs.

(Tags: Bulk calls)

bot_id.description:
Agent to run the campaign. Defaults to the agent attached
to `phone_number_id`; required when the number has none.

call_conditions.description:
Dial only the contacts that match every condition; the rest
are kept as `Skipped`. See Filtering in the guide below.

column.description: Key on the contact row to test.

operator.description:
`contains` is case-insensitive. `greater_than` and
`less_than` compare numerically, and a row whose value
is not a number fails the condition rather than
erroring.

concurrent_call_limit.description: Maximum number of concurrent calls allowed.

contact_list.description:
Who to call. Each row needs `phone_number`; any other key
reaches the agent as context for that one call.

enabled_reschedule_call.description: Enable automatic call rescheduling. When enabled the system can reschedule unreachable calls.

is_dynamic.description:
A dynamic campaign stays alive accepting contacts via the
add-contact webhooks, and `contact_list` becomes optional.

is_scheduled.description: Whether the campaign should be scheduled for future execution.

name.description: Name of the bulk call campaign.

phone_number_id.description:
The number this campaign calls from. With a `rotation`, the
rotation numbers dial instead and this one is the standby.

retry_config.description: Auto-retry configuration object containing retry settings.

retry_limit.description:
Retry attempts, 1 to 10. To disable retries omit it and
leave `auto_retry` false; never send `0`.

retry_schedule_days.description: Days to wait before a scheduled retry.

retry_schedule_hours.description: Hours to wait before a scheduled retry.

rotation.description:
Rotate the campaign across several of your numbers, so no
single number burns out. See Rotation in the guide below.

calls_per_number.description: Calls before moving on. Used by `fixed_count` and `both`.

fallback.description:
When every number is unhealthy: `pause` the campaign,
or `continue_best` with the healthiest one.

health_threshold.description:
Health score below which a number is rotated away from.
Used by `cpr_threshold` and `both`.

numbers.description:
The numbers to rotate across; each must be yours and
listed once.

phone_number_id.description: One of your numbers, from List phone numbers.

strategy.description:
When to move to the next number: every
`calls_per_number` calls, on low health score, both, or
never.

save_as_draft.description:
Store the campaign without dialing; start it later with the
start endpoint. See Drafts in the guide below.

scheduled_datetime.description: Scheduled execution time in format `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (required if `is_scheduled` is true).

name: createBulkCall
